caption:
hotel gym with three machines and it still built me a real session

#fitnessapp #gym #soma

slides.text:
A hotel gym with
three machines

I took one photo
of the room

It read what was there

Not what a template
assumed I'd have

And rebuilt the session
around it

Same forty minutes

Different equipment,
same day of the plan

slides.heading: Train wherever you actually are
slides.body: Photograph any room and SOMA rebuilds today's session around the equipment that is really there
